app.name: EyesUp
app.tagline: Learn to type without looking at the keyboard.

welcome.title: EyesUp
welcome.body: Learn to type with your eyes on the screen. No account needed.

orient.title: Orient
orient.posture: Sit tall, wrists soft, screen at eye level.
orient.home: Rest your index fingers on the F and J bumps.
orient.zones: Each finger stays in its own colour zone.
orient.eFinger: E is typed with the left middle finger.
orient.rFinger: R is typed with the left index finger.
orient.oFinger: O is typed with the right ring finger.
orient.done: Press Enter when you are ready
orient.next: Press Enter for the next step

probeA.title: Type normally for 45 seconds
probeA.hint: Look at the screen. Type as you usually do.
probeA.passage: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog and keeps going with steady hands on the home row today

probeB.title: Home position and blind check
probeB.home: Press the key for the highlighted finger.
probeB.passage: blind typing line with common words here for the probe

today.title: Today
today.start: Press Enter to start today's session
today.crossoverReached: Blind speed has overtaken your day-one sighted speed
today.dipExplainer: Retrain often feels slower before it feels faster. That dip is expected.
today.commitWeekOffer: All letters unlocked at 25 WPM blind — start a 7-day eyes-up week?

practice.handsReady: Rest on F and J, then press both together

progress.title: Progress
progress.heatmapHint: Numbers show confidence; colour is a secondary cue

library.title: Library
library.ownTextBody: Paste text to practise (stays on this device)

settings.title: Settings
settings.trackKeepProgress: Key progress is kept when the track changes
settings.deleteConfirm: Type DELETE then press Enter to confirm

device.title: EyesUp needs a keyboard
device.body: Open this link on a computer with a physical keyboard to practise.

update.ready: A new version is ready. It will load between sessions.
